card_roles.text:
Interface: proper characteristic-zero recognizable series f on n symbols, hidden-state bound m; exact FULL matrix-output oracle, not passive samples. Explicit Volterra T_i dimension2nm; f≠0⇒f(ℓT_1,…,ℓT_n)≠0 for someℓ∈{1,…,m}. Direct-sum dimension2nm²; acyclic full-output case one unscaled2nm tuple suffices. Joint strict triangularity makes evaluations legal.
Proof mechanism: released116 finite-word hyperlog independence→bivariate Volterra kernel→covariant rational row span detects a nonzero diagonal derivative before m→degree bounds/Cauchy interpolation→small scalar grid. Exact alias AB−B(I+A)^−1A(I+B) has leading commutator but vanishes at unscaled J_1,J_2 at EVERY truncation; greater dimension alone fails.
Learner: minimal r≤m realization, ≤m(1+nr) exact matrix queries of dimension≤2nm(r+1), feature length4n²m³. Residual combinations share transitions (m bound); unrelated hypothesis comparison may need2m. Independent batched width2n: maxdimension2n(m+r)≤4nm, calls≤m+nm²r. Charge full output entries, coefficient heights, elimination, execution/stability; field arithmetic≠bit time; no positive stochastic realization guarantee.
Critical novelty correction: release116+routine truncation/unrolling/length marker ALREADY implies polynomial proper-cyclic capability at O(nm^5) query dimension. Increment=compactness/charged query tradeoff, not first post-release polynomial learnability. Pre-release comparator quasipolynomial; scaling/output-only learning old. Practical useful oracle acquisition and independent proof/priority remain open.
Evidence reported:9adversarial fixtures×2modes,18 exact all-word/minimal-rank checks,1230 queries/1847592 returned field entries; cyclic rank4:45calls/dim80 vs205calls/dim32,batched slower. Other3fixtures75queries14.40s;14-query discriminator1.516s/75264inputbits/42359responsebits. Not a universal execution benchmark.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
For the complete finite periodic helical rotor with positive counted masses, the actual ground-band inertia obeys 1/B_eff=f/B0+(1-f)/B, B=B0+Ig^2. A finite lock attaining a fixed fraction of B needs barrier order E_R log^2(B/B0), attained by an explicit positive two-harmonic lock. Finite isolated preparation/response/readout and isolated/full loaded Gibbs range are proved as distinct operations/ensembles. A stronger b=R log^2 R lock gives the full equilibrium real-time/spectral limit; a positive heat deficit follows only under the stated inclusive KMS/scattering contract. The actual bare momentum pY=P-gL, unlike helical P, has a divergent kinetic lower bound in this family.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Literal H=pY^2/(2B0)+L^2/(2I)+V(phi-gY), compact angle, finite smooth periodic V, counted translating/rotating mass; added spring k=kappa/B and actual finite-band Rubin leads where specified. Fixed-I large-g family, finite pinned regulators before local lead/gain limits. Isolated response additionally needs the declared fresh cosine packet/N=0 stock, isolation switch, controlled normal ramp, finite hold and calibrated finite-aperture qubit meter.

BOUNDARIES
Band curvature, prepared isolated packet and full Gibbs state are different claims. The sharp response barrier is not proved sufficient for the stronger live dynamical limit. The earlier fixed-P small-flux preparation gate is not automatically valid at b=R log^2 R. Heat requires equilibrium KMS input/output completeness and no unassigned persistent bound memory; those premises and finite Gibbs/NESS preparation remain unproved here. Kinetic bounds are not dissipated heat or an all-mechanical/topology lower bound. Finite material rigidity, pitch, force/bandwidth, switches, field-generator mass/energy and readout are unacquired. Third-party ancestry is cited by the proofs, not republished or independently novelty-cleared.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
At fixed I,B0, low-band response pays recoil E_R proportional to R, barrier O(R log^2 R), force/stiffness and shrinking pitch. The sufficient live-dynamical choice pays barrier O(R^3 log^4 R), normal reference energy O(R^2 log^2 R), force O(R^(7/2) log^4 R), curvature O(R^4 log^4 R), pitch O(R^-1/2). Actual bare kinetic lower orders are R log R at the logarithmic equilibrium lock and R^2 log^2 R at the stronger lock. Preparation, hold of order B, finite readout amplitude/slew, fresh stock and confidence are paid; neither ground energy nor equilibrium kinetic fluctuations are a per-use dissipation claim.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire finite material/control/preparation/current interfaces before claiming a thermal device. Use the operation-specific source rather than transferring the isolated ramp or a low-band inertia to a live heat experiment.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
For a positive pinned Gaussian mechanical support H_G with coordinate-only coupling -lambda Q v^Tq to one bounded Hermitian internal force, exact interacting Matsubara/contact identities imply Gamma_p<=Gamma_p,G, coordinate variance increase<=lambda^2 C^2 Var(Q), total spring-energy increase<=E*=lambda^2 C q_*^2/2 and kinetic-energy decrease<=E*/4. The half-offset canonical rotor with Q=2cos(phi) retains its full infinite charge ladder: exact anticommuting J and C symmetries pair all eta=0 sectors, the detuning is off-sector, actual mechanical/rotor kinetic energies stay uniformly bounded, and a fixed-parameter regime has a nonzero sector port dipole.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
H_G=p^T M^-1 p/2+q^T Kq/2 with constant positive M,K and Y=v^Tq; H=H_G+H_A-lambda QY, ||Q||<=q_*, no mechanical momentum coupling or extra thermal port. C=v^TK^-1v remains bounded before the local lead limit. The canonical extension separately needs the complete rotor H_eta=H_G+E_R(N-1/2-eta)^2-lambda Y(2cos phi), actual half-offset/even force, symmetric charge cutoffs/form limit and the declared fixed spring/temperature parameters.

BOUNDARIES
The finite-internal bounded-force theorem is not an arbitrary coupling or spin-exclusive theorem; the infinite rotor has its own domain/trace-limit argument. Exact J protection requires eta=0 and its actual symmetry assumptions; cosine bias can break sector pairing and sine defects can break J. The full rotor normal ladder is not a free Pauli doublet; the detuning actuator is unbounded. The rotor result proves equilibrium memory, energy and force, not eta-dependent cold response, the earlier spin heat law, finite Gibbs/NESS preparation or control precision. Conserved static Q can saturate the static bound while supplying no heat scattering. The final intake preserves and statically reads the diagnostic scripts; numerical outputs remain source-reported and were not replayed or whole-code audited. No measured device, priority or practical advantage is established.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Finite energy is relative to the unchanged complete Gaussian baseline: only explicit mechanical excess is finite, not an infinite reservoir total. E*=lambda^2 C q_*^2/2 bounds spring increase; kinetic decrease<=E*/4. For rotor Q norm2, fixed E_R,lambda,k0,T0 give a uniform actual angular kinetic bound. A sufficient dipole regime E_R>=128K* and E_R/(k_B T0)>=10 may be fixed once; this is not free material/cooling/flux or a preparation protocol. Half-offset precision, Ycos(phi) coupling over the whole line, field-generator extent/mass/energy, source and readout are actual unacquired interfaces.

NEXT OBLIGATION
N1012 now supplies finite-clock sector response and low-energy relative detuning control at their separate linear-profile premises, plus a finite-aperture static/resource extension. Finite-temperature infrared/cold susceptibility and compatible preparation/current/force hardware remain open. Static degeneracy and bounded energy alone do not supply heat blocking.

EXACT CLAIM
For a supplied unknown quadratic permutation Q on F2^n accessed by chosen-pair lexicographic comparisons and actual fresh native bits, acquired quadratic coordinate programs compute global or prefix-dependent affine checkpoints. The conditional frame constructor yields exact witness-conditioned prefix sampling during acquisition and a closed requested-output inverse after expiry, with parameter g_cond<=g and polynomial storage. Fixed bad-address mass<=1/1024 with arbitrary causal replies touching bad endpoints is tolerated by direct votes and a short-fibre win census; the logical comparison ceiling is3577*n*D_n*R. Internal failure delta*2^-n gives bounded-error expected bit/known-code work polynomial times(2^g_cond+delta), while worst-case work remains exponential.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
The quadratic-permutation and significance-order promises, native chosen addresses/XOR arithmetic, supplied request witnesses during acquisition, fresh external fair bits and the exact or explicitly fixed-bad-address comparator contract. Previously acquired prefixes must be correct on the coupled good event; actual code, polar kernels, complements, scans, rejections and caps are paid.

BOUNDARIES
This recovers the promised underlying Q, not arbitrary corrupted rank bits or an acquired model-class/noise certificate. B is fixed before fresh tapes; good-good comparisons must be correct. A selected fibre may be entirely bad. Worst-context g_cond is an analysis parameter, not cheaply certified from visited contexts. Missing final equality or missing requested x in a collected fibre returns UNKNOWN. Expected bounded-error work is not Las Vegas correctness or all-branch FPT. No historical-six-source guards, universal future-task coverage, physical latency guarantee, new experiment or advantage over equally informed retainers follows. N780 remains stronger on its complete scalar-triangular overlap.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
D_n=1+n+binom(n,2); direct511 votes and census for fibres<=64 give3577*n*D_n*R comparisons. Each local frame scan costs conservatively O(n^5); proposal/collection caps charge all bits, rejected candidates, code and source calls. The general epsilon<1/84 theorem pays polynomial cost in1/(1/28-3epsilon), not merely its bit length. Closed inversion costs<=n*2^g_cond trials plus matrix/code work. Running with internal allowance delta*2^-n pays larger finite caps and confidence work; separately unbounded source/physical latency is not hidden.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the source class, actual comparison/native-bit interfaces and useful future task relation before claiming a practical learner. Keep the operation theorem separate from observed capability, historical confidence or a retaining-comparator lower bound.

EXACT CLAIM
An odd finite C2 aperture w_L(Y) preserves exact canonical J/C memory sectors and a nonzero full-ladder static dipole at fixed L, E_R and force resources. Its nonlinear curvature contact c=<lambda*w_L"*Q> changes the full KMS covariance identity; complete host kinetic/spring EXCESS remains bounded, while exact linear momentum domination is not inherited. Separately, a finite detuning pulse has actual all-mode transition probability A^2/64<=P<=K_*A^2 under declared state-moment/control premises. Fixed-gap full-charge Schur elimination supplies an explicit normal-tail bound and a relative eta transverse correction, with common selfenergy and reconstruction metric retained. None is a canonical cold-heat theorem.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual full canonical charge ladder and Gaussian host/leads, fixed positive port spring and masses, symmetry/offset contract; finite far-pinned and charge regulators before the stated limits. Aperture w_L=Y*chi(Y/L) with actual force/curvature bounds. Finite response uses the linear-force full-ladder model, declared joint reference Y,D moments, supplied sector preparation and actual finite eta/readout controls. Low-energy resolvent needs its explicit form/spectral-region and q<=1/2 conditions.

BOUNDARIES
The finite-aperture static/resource proof, linear-profile finite-pulse theorem and low-energy resolvent have different hypotheses. Do not silently apply the latter two unchanged to the finite-aperture profile. Curvature may have either sign, so Gamma_p<=Gamma_p,G is not a nonlinear-profile conclusion. A finite-pulse spectrum/moment bound does not control infrared weight or a joint eta,T remainder. Schur inverse equality is not equality of thermal ensembles, generators or observables; an extensive finite-T reservoir is not a fixed global-energy window. No free TLS, Gaussian bath vertex, inclusive-current completeness, finite Gibbs/NESS preparation, measured flux/force/readout or practical advantage follows.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Choose fixed E_R and L^2>46M2 for static memory; active extent4L, forceF0=19lambda/2 and curvatureD0=(15lambda/2+40lambda/sqrt3)/L are paid. Nonlinear absolute host excess bounds retain C*F0^2/8 and curvature terms. Finite pulse pays actual offset peak/slew, joint moments and state-induced source work; actual sector-sensitive detection is not supplied. Normal resolutionN costs a q^(2N)/(E_R(1-q)) operator tail plus Gaussian matrix/integration work; the common energy-dependent correction and metric are real resources, not discarded errors.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Determine the actual finite-temperature infrared/cold response with its preparation/current/material interfaces. Fixed-resource static memory, finite response and UV relative control are reusable premises; they do not settle transport or the mission.

EXACT CLAIM
In the declared finite closed Na/K/Cl/water model with an added uncalibrated outward-Na photopump and ATPase off during light, passive K/Cl stationarity forces Vm=EK=ECl and reduces stationary composition to a scalar volume root. Gross productive photon turnover is charged separately from net stored ion/capacitor energy. The source reportsImax=150pA+NaV suppression for200s returning to its healthy basin after an1800s ordinary-ATPase handoff, whileImax=100pA for600s stores more total gradient energy yet relapses. The numerical comparison is a reported model discriminator, not an accepted tissue/optical-advantage result.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Specified reconstructed single-cell transport equations and added finite-bath model,0.5pL initial extracellular allocation and600s ATPase-off preparation, imposed NaV control, uncalibrated pure-Na pump law Km=5mM/drive30kJ per mol and525nm productive-photon account. Light withdrawal restores original NaV and ordinary ATPase for1800s. The washed-out earlier endpoint preparation is a different state.

BOUNDARIES
The model healthy classifier is not physiological viability or tissue recovery. The pure-Na pump law, current waveform/load, expression/retinal, switches, optical access and blocker are unacquired. Static folds do not certify dynamic stability, basin boundaries or minimal waveform. first_sampled_ionic_return_after_handoff_s=0 is not durable return. Native350pA qualitative return agrees across retained methods, but precise transient photon dose is unconverged. Ordinary ATPase plus temporary NaV suppression also succeeds without light. Whole ODE implementation/integrations and cited biology were not whole-audited; generic Na optopumping/mitochondrial photon ATP are established alternatives, not new mechanisms claimed here.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge gross photopump turnover: reportedImax=150pA+block200s exports260.4982fmol Na for only50.5716fmol net intracellular loss, stores0.365377nJ, delivers3.311276nJ ionic work, and costs at least59.357152nJ productive photons before optical/futile-cycle losses. Its later ATPase handoff consumes reported496.632fmol ATP. FailedImax=100pA+block600s stores0.417412nJ but uses at least116.528312nJ photons. These are source-reported model accounts, not acquired doses or safety estimates; actual sustained ATP free energy is not certified by ATP counts.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire actual sustained load-dependent pump/control/optical and biological interfaces and a converged whole-operation model before any practical restoration claim. Preserve failure on withdrawal and ordinary comparators; mission remains NOT_ACHIEVED.

EXACT CLAIM
An all-to-all irreversible matching race among n desired handle pairs gives Pcorrect=product_{j=0}^{n-1}(1+j*beta/k)^(-1), while a uniform bound D*beta on each remaining site's wrong-partner hazard gives Pcorrect>=(1+D*beta/k)^(-n). Independent multivalent rebinding can make perfect-sink clearance exponential in arm count. Ideal whole-prefix reset has E[R]=1+L*(1-p)/p rounds but wastes (1-p)*L*(L-1)/2 successful downstream bonds. Independently rooted b-edge packets reduce within-packet waste, excluding fusion. Equal total catalyst exposure alone gives no repair advantage in the common-rate-scaling model.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual registered reactive handles, constant intended/wrong hazards or their explicitly bounded spatial alternative; for reset, independent identical per-edge success, no wrong bonds/damage, complete unrooted-island clearance and retained rooted product in the original register. Multivalent clearance assumes independent arms and an absorbing wash sink. These are model premises, not demonstrated CuAAC reset capabilities.

BOUNDARIES
This differs from N992's imine checkpoint and does not supersede its reader/reset obstructions. Root connectivity, full mass and end identifiers do not certify sequence: ((m-1)!)^2 alternating orders share those observations for2m distinct monomers with fixed endpoint types/identities. That count does not imply the alternatives occur. Irreversible wrong rooted bonds pass a connectivity filter. The quadratic race law requires all-to-all constant rates; bounded access is a different and favorable interface. Packet isolation, reliable fusion/root removal, preserved recognition adapters and repeated re-registration remain unacquired. Cleaving coding adapters can destroy positional information needed for another retry. Source-cited component chemistry is not independently reverified, and reported simulations are not replayed.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Every reaction, discarded correct bond, reset, clearance time, root damage and connector is charged. E[within-packet waste]=(1-p)*L*(b-1)/2 for b dividing L excludes fusion. Independent connector failure q gives model Ptotal=Pcorrect(b)^(L/b)*(1-q)^(L/b-1), not a physical optimum. Complete clearance of N required tethers has probability c^N under independent per-tether cleavage probability c in its stringent topology; alternative release changes that model. Actual time is not determined by round counts; wash/reagent/damage and code/preparation costs remain.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire small-system missed-junction repair with retained correct bonds, complete multivalent clearance, permanent register, mixed-program wrong-link control and separately qualified fusion. Compare matched uninterrupted exposure; no integrated factory, measured selectivity or practical advantage is established.

EXACT CLAIM
The earlier symmetric four-arm two-hit shared-window model retains its N^-1/2 tail. A mechanically useful preanchor changes the required operation to one additional old-side graft. With k=d and X=N*a*eta*theta*S, independent thinning under T~Exp(d) gives one-hit no-link failure(1-exp(-X))/X and fixed-m failure asymptotic m/X. This is a changed interface, not a refutation of the two-hit law. Correlated loss of every preanchor in a region imposes a ceiling that abundance cannot remove. A single usable terminus per chain also makes useful sites per mass proportional to a*e*theta*S/M when other kinetic/retention factors are held fixed. Neither a physical weld nor a cost advantage is acquired.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual old/new contact and a mechanically effective preanchor; fixed positive graft/shutdown rates; Poisson candidate count and independent candidate outcomes conditional on the common window. The product a*eta*theta*S must represent justified association, donor retention, old-side targeting and later individual service survival, distinct from shared regional delamination. Single-end mass accounting requires one usable terminus per chain and comparable end kinetics.

BOUNDARIES
Earlier two-hit/time-floor/contact results remain valid at their own interfaces. Cotton cellulose-I/II activity ratios cannot supply a native wet bacterial-interface rate. AFM adhesion energy is not bulk strength. Shared association loss cannot be folded into independent service survival. The reported hybrid221-versus332 reaction-site optimum remains source-reported: astra_xh2_hybrid_weld_test.py is unavailable, so its optimization/stochastic validation is not accepted. Reaction-site counts are not equal mass, energy or manufacture costs. Source-cited biochemical precedents are not newly primary-validated; correct xyloglucan production, sustained association and donor-safe wet load transfer remain unacquired.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY

EXACT CLAIM
For the whole real symmetric ball ||S-S0||op<=R and arbitrary unit real probes returning S*q with adversarial Euclidean error<=eta, the deterministic adaptive minimax radius for tr(T*S) after at most k vector calls is eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. The tail omits the k largest positive and k largest negative eigenvalue magnitudes separately; eta>=R gives the prior radius R*||T||_*. A complete exact Loewner interval supports a transformed noiseless inertia theorem; an outer interval only gives a certificate. Two native nonlinear forward calls can implement a bounded approximate Jacobian action under supplied symmetry/smoothness/error promises. A genuine scalar bilinear instrument ties one-task precision but can discard future-use information.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
A fixed finite real symmetric source, the actual whole norm-ball prior, late symmetric task T, freely selectable unit real inputs and the declared per-call worst-case error contract. Exact-interval and native nonlinear/scalar transfers each require their separately supplied geometry, smoothness, detector and error interfaces; they are not inferred from finite source records.

BOUNDARIES
N997's general operator/history and fixed-menu results remain valid and distinct; N996's vector/transpose grammar is not imported. Restricted/rational-only inputs, extra source structure, additional joint noise restrictions or noncentral history can change the sharp value. Outer noisy posteriors do not inherit the full-family lower bound. Nonlinear reduction is sound, not globally minimax over all native nonlinear procedures. A C5 strongly convex bump defeats unguarded derivative transfer from finite gradient data. Programmable scalar readout is an actual additional native interface, not free compression of a previously measured vector. Same-information optimal-recovery/retaining procedures tie; no device, physical calibration, lifetime advantage or historical priority is established.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge each full-vector call as n returned coordinates; scalar bilinear calls return one number only if that detector is genuinely available and calibrated. Nonlinear response actions cost two actual forward calls each. Pay eigendirections, arithmetic, real-input precision/preparation, retained records and actual error/prior acquisition. The source-reported six-port examples use four nonlinear forward calls/24 coordinates and two scalar calls versus twelve vector coordinates for one task; these are conditional software workloads, not measured hardware savings. Four original result JSONs are preserved as raw reports, not independently replayed numerical evidence.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire/falsify usable symmetry, prior geometry, allowed input/readout directions and smoothness/error contracts on real sources. Calibrate physical costs and future-task objectives before claiming instrument or learning advantage; preserve uncertain/outer-family gaps instead of inheriting sharpness.

EXACT CLAIM
For finite d and bounded Q>=B*I, B>0, the completed full-code Hamiltonian H_eta+B=R_eta^*Q*R_eta, R_eta=(eta*W,I), W=Q^-1*G, has a parallel dressed code and a scalar schedule with isometry error <=[2(d+1)*ell+5*ell^2]/(B*T), ell<=d*pi/2, without commutation of bath/controller matrices. A proper-subcode bare penalty changes the contract: an explicit three-state family has an almost-conserved competing direction forcing time of order sqrt(lambda)/a for fixed positive loading probability under every allowed shared scalar envelope. Independently gate the off-code source, load C first, then restore it with all matrix cross-counterterms: the loaded code is fixed exactly and Stage II adds no ideal isometry error.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
A closed coherent finite-code model, bounded positive finite-band Q, known G and calibrated matrix counterterm eta^2*G^*Q^-1*G. The full-code ramp has no extra penalty selecting a proper subcode. The repair additionally requires separate off-code source gating and the complete time-dependent cross-counterterms. Use well-defined unitary propagators and fixed input/output code isometries.

BOUNDARIES
A dressed eigenstate and zero Berry self-connection do not imply reachability under restricted controls. Bare-penalty gap collapse alone is not a time lower bound; the explicit nearly invariant vector supplies that stronger result. Uniform state error in bandwidth/mode count/coupling strength does not bound work, slew, noise or calibration. Exact Stage II invariance does not validate perturbed hardware. No native endpoint-only Jacobi interface, physical apparatus, novelty, practical advantage or all-N capacity-two theorem is acquired. N998 and earlier different gapless-response interfaces remain unchanged.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Use hbar=1: B*T is dimensionless. Full-code sufficient duration is [d(d+1)*pi+5*d^2*pi^2/4]/(B*epsilon). Pay model acquisition, eigenschedule, full matrix compensation, switching, source amplitudes and precision. Canceling detuning/coupling work does not make gross work finite. In the explicit repaired family a relative cross-counterterm error epsilon_c leaves instantaneous code residual |epsilon_c|*Q*|tau|*lambda^(3/2)/sqrt(1+lambda); order1/lambda relative accuracy controls that residual, not an automatic gate-error bound. Finite propagation/high-precision numbers are producer reports, not current replay or measurements.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the selective source, full compensation and stable calibration from a physically constrained microscopic interface; quantify actual noise, work, slew and preparation/readout. Keep the restricted-envelope impossibility separate from stronger supplied controls and preserve the open all-sector spectral problem.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
Postbond rejection can improve conditional purity without restoring original-root yield: with correct/wrong irreversible attempt probabilities p,w and ideal readers, correct L-step yield is at most[p/(p+w)]^L. Endless iid false reads of a persistent wrong product eventually admit it. Complete donor-owned reset and no premature chemistry give precommit wrong/correct odds (lambda_W/lambda_C)*[(k+u_C)/(k+u_W)]^n; any fixed premature-coupling hazard changes the large-n limit. Any receipt test has alpha-beta<=TV(P_C,P_W) for its actual observation laws. Clearance of unjoined donors and preservation of registered roots obey a separate wash-time feasibility bound; it does not distinguish stable wrong covalent bonds. Two99% factors multiply to98.01%, not99%, under the declared product model. In a shielded/reactive two-register model, harmless shielded hydrolysis hS cancels from per-encounter wrong/correct odds at fixed other hazards. With immediate independent harmless same-parent replenishment it also cancels from eventual correct-root yield and mean time to any permanent decision. With per-encounter C,W,H,Droot and replacement loss delta, correct-root yield becomes C/[C+W+Droot+delta*H]; successful-recovery time tau changes mean decision time.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Actual correct/wrong chemical classes and rooted parent competence; identical renewal attempts or the separately declared exponential checkpoint model; full reset on donor departure, chemically latent intermediate states and a counted terminal commitment. Receipt laws must concern the same actual product/nuisance class as the proposed acceptance test. Wash model needs no rebinding, exponential loss and retained register. The two-register model additionally requires fixed exponential hazards, q,k>0 and chi in[0,1]; replacement returns to the same competent shielded start.

BOUNDARIES
A continuity-only DNA signal, full mass or donor activation does not establish bond site or sequence. Wrong stable covalent product and unjoined donor are different observation classes: the wash nuisance decay cannot be assigned to wrong rooted bonds. Long-chain products use the specified independent/identical stage or conditional product law. All rates, memory-retention CTMC thresholds and joint optimizations are hypothetical/producer-reported; current code is missing. Source-cited DNA proofreading, associative-toehold and latent furan-PNA components are not an acquired integrated assembler, serial masked-growth route or new priority result. N992 and N1016 retain their distinct accepted versions and chemical/reset gaps. Permanent decision includes root death; mean decision time is not time to correct manufacture. The new checkpoint source counts premature matched-donor chemistry as wrong, unlike the earlier leak model; their limits cannot be blended. The full note includes dA in DA, while the abbreviated response omits it.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Count starting roots, correct-root yield, full-length output fraction and conditional purity separately. Precommit qualification pays rejected arrivals, reset/fuel, residence time and actual commitment chemistry. Premature reactions and activated-donor escape are additional hazards. Wash pays time and irreversible register loss. For product reliability target Ftotal, allocate factors with product>=Ftotal under an actual justified product model; adding two99% factors is insufficient. A matched staged masked NHS-PNA process remains the source-proposed comparator; no measured improvement or source-code replay is supplied. Ideal replenishment omits dead time, damage, waste poisoning and rate changes. Count donor encounters and paid recovery; a hydrolysis-protection factor is not a selectivity factor.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire donor-owned reset, chemically latent preauthorization states, actual site/sequence-sensitive covalent receipt, compatible masked next terminus, activated-donor clearance and register handoff. Measure the joint physical error/time/yield law before combining separately favorable components.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
In the ideal equal-load one-scission interface with nu effective paths per area, peak traction=nu*f and scission work/area=nu*U_b, so their ratio is U_b/f. Required traction alone supplies no general fracture-work bound. Ideal constant-traction pullout gives work/area=sigma*ell and pays aligned fibre packing/material plus consumed sliding inventory. If each repair adds a seam that remains in series, n repairs create n(n+1)/2 independent seam-interval exposures. For periodic deep resets, n,k are positive integers,1<=k<=n, q=ceil(n/k), m_j=k for j<q and m_q=n-k*(q-1). EXACT CLAIM
A shared-boundary linear elastic bridge compares repair stiffness under positive tensile drive; finite probes require joint calibration and zero drive supplies no signal. Cubic nutrient closure and observation aliases retain their separate accepted units. Delayed precursor stock can keep adding stiffness after feed stops. For a linear port with delta=delta0/(1+k*R), equilibrium spring energy is k*delta0^2/[2*(1+k*R)^2], maximized at k=1/R with delta0^2/(8*R). The potential drop delta0^2/(2*R) is available only from a specified constrained initial port state, not as free work from an already relaxed comparator. A closing conjugate force pair Fb changes readout to(delta0-R*Fb)/(1+k*R); a single-midpoint force uses a different compliance.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Quasistatic positive Hookean stiffnesses, fixed common displacement/geometry and actual force attachment. The spring bound uses R>0,k>=0 and the stated linear port. Work release additionally requires a prepared initial state and paid loading/reset path. Earlier cubic, stock, calibration and observation units retain their own assumptions; no physical valve follows from a signal equation.

BOUNDARIES
A1038 remains current for the three unchanged earlier units. New code describes its Fb formula as force on one midpoint, but R*Fb is the equal-and-opposite differential-force case; do not transfer it to arbitrary one-node pressure. The source stationary energy formula alone does not establish releasable work from a freely relaxed state or a repeatable energy-harvesting cycle. Component papers, dimensional valve/flow/noise/oxygen/pH examples and randomized checks remain source reports. No integrated pilot/culture, absolute strength/fatigue certificate or practical advantage is acquired.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge mechanical loading, clamps/latches, force balancing, energy capture/storage/reset, noise margin and references. Near balance the modeled port energy is quadratic in stiffness error at fixed drive. Hydraulic pressure can provide power while biasing the sensing force. Feedstock, oxygen, pH, fouling, membrane resistance, useful conversion and old-new load transfer remain separate acquired interfaces; an equally informed external sensor/pump/culture remains the comparator.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the actual pressure-balanced pilot, prepared/reset mechanical work path, stable force geometry, calibrated drive/noise and useful old-new load transfer. Measure the complete valve/membrane/culture supply law; source examples do not acquire it.

EXACT CLAIM
Here audits are sacrificial TEST probes and USE calls carry real quantum payloads. Fresh uniform private two-bit Pauli masking of a qubit makes its entire accessible input I_D/2 tensor rho_ME, matching a uniform six-state test through the same complete physical call. Under trusted framing or trusted Bell preparation/terminal teleportation and retired fine records, direct masking and entanglement-first deferred use produce the same Pauli-labelled CP use maps and coarse per-axis pass/fail bath instruments, even for correlated input and memory. With genuine positive USE branches and a uniform operator lower bound on the actual test effect, a predictable private test coin supports an all-prefix virtual-fault budget with paid mismatch. Retaining individual detector outcomes can change future bath updates despite matching test failure rates. Complete-instrument substitution and the weaker effect-only budget therefore retain separate conditions; exposed/reused keys, unmatched ports or an untrusted final gate do not inherit either guarantee automatically.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
One identified logical qubit and a complete CPTP call including all future-accessible bath/registers; the same physical port/call, fresh keys independent of the initial input/reference and apparatus state, private role choices and actual trusted input/output operations. Complete-instrument substitution uses destructive tests and retirement of carriers, keys and fine records from future-used state/control, with only coarse-history reuse. The weaker statistical extension may use a different bath-disturbing TEST, but needs an actual positive USE refinement, uniform full-memory operator bound, predictable parameters and fresh private role choices.

BOUNDARIES
Input-state masking does not close timing/control/routing side channels or certify its own trusted framing. Equivalence concerns the specified Pauli-twirled effective service, not unmodified arbitrary-channel teleportation or every fine-record history. A virtual nonidentity branch is not an observed microscopic fault, conditional output fidelity, QEC independence, future-safe stream or unlimited availability. Biased/coherent USE mismatch generally loses the positive path and needs a finite-block channel allowance instead. Known quantum one-time pads, Pauli twirling, teleportation and sequential estimation are prior methods; no new priority or advantage is acquired. Existing N1004 conditional pulse bounds do not acquire these complete physical interfaces.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Direct transmission pays two fresh private bits per qubit, actual matched routing and trusted input/output Pauli controls, and consumes an unknown message when used. Deferred use pays a fresh protected Bell pair/local half, isolated candidate, protected payload holding until late choice, and trusted Bell measurement/correction. Both pay destructive tests, retired records, physical isolation, duration, gate/source errors and calibration. Mismatch accumulates risk-credit cost and can reduce admitted uses; an equally informed conventional controller can use the same interface.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Construct and uniformly calibrate an actual complete boundary, including preparation, routing/timing secrecy, output isolation, record retirement and terminal operations. Acquire a full-memory test-effect relation if using the mismatch certificate; finite favorable observations do not supply a future uniform promise.

EXACT CLAIM
Represent retained product-guide obstruction by simultaneous blocking sets at each reaction port. Three sites can each tolerate either earlier product alone yet always jam the final reaction when both guides remain. A safe alternate port makes completion possible but gives only1/3 success under identical independent simultaneous reaction clocks. For prerequisite-free single-port pairwise obstruction between distinct sites, minimum exact immediate safe guide releases equal directed feedback-vertex-set size; this does not extend automatically to cooperative blocks. Marginal guide clearance does not determine joint jamming. Chemically self-inactivating correct products permit sensorless retries under an identical-parent absorbing model, while permanent wrong acylation bounds infinite-retry yield. Self-cleaving donor attachment and physical duplex clearance are separate proposed operations.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Known monotone retained-guide blocker sets and actual ports. Outcome-aware release needs an observed successful bond and exact harmless guide removal preserving product. Pairwise FVS requires one port, no prerequisites and i!=j. Blind equal-order probabilities need independent simultaneous identical per-site first-success clocks. Retry products must self-inactivate; competent misses and constant probabilities are supplied, with independence for product yields.

BOUNDARIES
Feasible scheduling does not acquire blind reliability or a bond receipt. Pairwise FVS excludes cooperative blocks, prerequisites and self arcs. Cleanup and across-site/motif independence require separate support. Donor-link cleavage does not eject duplexes, restore register or prevent wrong acylation. Component literature/numerics remain source reports. The source zero-feed bug at p+w=1 remains visible: accepted Y_0=0; positive-feed examples are unaffected.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay site/port mapping, product-qualified observation for outcome-aware scheduling, harmless guide release, root preservation, independent feed opportunities, wash/displacement, wrong-site chemistry and finite staging failures. Exact subset compilation is finite exponential search, not free scheduling. Removing covalent donor attachment does not remove cleanup or permanent wrong products. Equal-information staged NHS chemistry, static optimized tethers and source-cited enzyme cascades remain comparators; no measured advantage or priority is acquired.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the actual joint retention/footprint map, root-preserving guide displacement, stable site competence, chemical-address selectivity and idempotent product topology. Use preset-neighbor challenges and product-resolving measurements to distinguish cooperative inhibition from other chemistry, then evaluate complete finite-time yield and costs against matched retaining/staged controls.

EXACT CLAIM
If a fixed Euclidean forward law is F(x)=m*x+A(x),Lip(A)<=a<m, then H=F^-1=c*I+B with c=m/(m^2-a^2),Lip(B)<=b=a/(m^2-a^2), and conversely. Old full-vector forward calls become inverse residual observations. Pairwise constraints on all old and future forces describe the complete compatible global class; independent future balls lose same-source information. Single-query scalar supports admit sparse weighted-ball certificates under Slater; selected rational weights give sound outer bounds, not guaranteed optima. Near saturation retains square-root ambiguity, adversarial bias has an accuracy floor, and finite observations cannot certify the global source contract. On constrained inputs, projected VI is a different operation with contraction a/m and outer history balls.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Stable forward full-vector source, Euclidean port semantics, independently justified m>0 and0<=a<m with the specific shifted residual bound. Exact native pairs for exact family claims; bounded measurement reports give only the stated outer envelopes. Unconstrained inverse acts on all R^d. Constrained VI additionally supplies a nonempty closed convex allowed set C, queries in C and an available metric projection.

BOUNDARIES
This is narrower than all strongly monotone Lipschitz maps and does not infer an energy potential, a Hessian or the physical contract from finite readings. Exact joint inverse sharpness is over the global residual-Lipschitz class, not a smoother physical family. Sparse existence needs nonempty interior and at least one finite historical ball; chosen dyadic certificates may be loose. Noisy balls and VI balls are outer only. Actual four-program clean replay remains a source report; original studies were not executed here. No physical source, independent architecture advantage or priority acquired.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Each learner call returns d scalars. In the synthetic inverse control six calls return12 scalars;32 cycle and50 task-setter/reference calls are separate. VI uses4+4*5=24 learner calls/72 scalars plus64 cycle,4 setter and20 baseline calls. The reported spatial certificate ceiling103 bits is local: acquired focused certificates reach326 bits, and the stored final inverse-radius denominator has582 bits. No global103-bit/CPU ceiling follows. Informed classical retaining/projected methods can tie; the saved VI final estimates and true errors match the equal-call baseline.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire a justified local/global physical validity and noise contract, then preserve shared-source constraints for the actual operation. Exact joint constrained-VI consistency and equal-information physical advantage remain open.

EXACT CLAIM
A covalently attached donor handle retained after a complete denaturing wash can witness a new covalent connection under the stated graph/isolation assumptions, but wrong-site bonds and orientation still alias. With IID rebuilt children and node acceptance q=p+f independent of size/protocol, balanced L=2^k fusion has expected consumption(2/q)^k leaf units before processing overhead; accepted-product purity needs independent correct-junction factors(p/q)^(L-1). Product-length-dependent q can restore exponential cost. Odd A-ended completed AA/BB fragments cannot terminally CuAAC-cyclize, yet the unmasked bridge has only1/6 correct endpoint pairs in the symmetric toy. Independent-clock clean-completion bounds and a verified1023-label code provide separate conditional tools, not a physical writer.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Covalent identifier/root attachment, no independent path or persistent nonspecific retention, complete noncovalent stripping, stable competent intended ports, correct leaves and known orientation. Rebuild models additionally supply IID per-node attempts, child destruction/rebuilding, explicit p/f and costs, and size/protocol-independent acceptance when invoking polynomial scaling or the boundary-only DP. Port/hazard/coding models each retain their separate assumptions.

BOUNDARIES
Connectivity and mass do not certify site, sequence or orientation. Safe completed fragments do not supply a safe fusion reaction. Correct two-end selection probability is not total accepted-product q without a specified reader/false-acceptance law; two-bond bridge success cannot be imported from one-junction rates. The source phrase n-monomer fragments is ambiguous: code uses total new product n, so child-length convention changes the exponent by two. No measured constant long-fragment q, outer-end masking, compatible label removal, integrated device or equal-resource advantage is acquired. Full demo imports absent astra_chemistry_distributed_edge_assembly; no result JSON/replay log supplied.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
C denotes EXPECTED consumption, not a hard or worst-case budget; q<1 permits arbitrarily many retries. Rejections consume both rebuilt children plus every join attempt; material per accepted product differs from verified-correct product, time, solvent, wash, feed and controller cost. Purity loses a factor p/(p+f) per independent junction. Odd fusion adds a B connector on every attempt and q concerns both required bonds. All rates and long-chain illustrative yields/costs are hypothetical model inputs. Established iterative exponential growth/orthogonal-chemistry comparators remain source-cited, not newly audited here.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire junction/orientation-sensitive acceptance, competent masked ends and recovery/label chemistry; measure whole-bridge p,f and their size dependence against an informed IEG comparator before claiming scalable manufacture.

EXACT CLAIM
A fixed rank-r subspace tracking an N-site normalized guided phase vector with uniform residual<=epsilon on phase width0<W<=2pi must satisfy r>=(1-epsilon^2)*N*W/(2pi) and a KyFan covariance capture condition. This is a representation constraint, not a count of physical poles or a gate certificate. Analytic variation bounds can enclose a chosen projected excitation and ideal angular radiation when their grid inputs are validated. At Bragg, equal reciprocal guided columns leave one photon input unchanged, giving error2 against the relative -I target. A smooth reciprocal nondegenerate one-orbital band also has zero slope there. Off-Bragg/multiband changes evade these restricted premises but do not certify full scattering. A separate Markov cavity model exposes full-output loss/cooperativity/bandwidth costs.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Declared equally spaced phase vector and fixed orthogonal projector for the modal theorem; supplied phase interval and norm target. Radiation geometry additionally needs normalized projection bounded away from zero, the stated ideal angular bath and validated grid/variation inputs. Bragg identity uses identical reciprocal local guided contacts, consistent free-reference port phases and an existing scattering limit. Band and cavity claims use their separately specified source classes.

BOUNDARIES
Top eigenmodes optimize average capture, not automatically worst-frequency error. Rank r is not r emitters/poles, and a full frequency-adaptive N-mode Hamiltonian is outside the fixed-subspace premise. Good on-shell overlap/radiation geometry is not an acquired passive off-shell response. Prepared single-channel operations are different from arbitrary two-sided -I. Current governing numerical code/results are unacquired: reported rank5, sub-percent geometry and failed optimizer values remain source reports, not independent interval certificates, Maxwell devices or global impossibility results. Positive internal form/capacity is not a continuum gap or a gate guarantee.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay N array sites, any required collective modes, actual control/capture/retrieval and complete baths/Maxwell calibration. The cavity comparator requires separate useful/intrinsic/emitter loss and coupling resources; its branch conditions are necessary, not joint band/device sufficiency or equal-resource advantage. Physical source, finite-time operations, historical priority and practical advantage remain unacquired.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the current numerical inputs and rigorously validate grid/eigensystem bounds, then realize an accessible passive multimode response with one full electromagnetic source and all ports. Compare full resources/finite-time operation against an informed cavity alternative.

EXACT CLAIM
For finite N>=2, supplied complex y,z and real symmetric nearest-neighbour H, nonzero s_j=Im(conj(y_j)*y_(j+1)) and Im<y,z>=0 determine a unique H satisfying Hy=z. Its hoppings are J_j=sum_(k<=j)Im(conj(y_k)*z_k)/s_j; the real diagonal follows row by row. This compiles one vector response at one design energy. It does not ensure a common response for several inputs, positive signal energy, a stable bath completion, uniform bandwidth or a physical gate. The source also reports failed five-mode dynamics and improved reciprocal/local numerical trials, whose governing files were not supplied.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
One supplied pair y,z at one design energy, N>=2 and a real symmetric tridiagonal matrix class. Check every adjacent current factor nonzero and the global imaginary inner product exactly zero. Reconstruct and verify the full Hy=z; positivity, simultaneous responses, full self-energy/source couplings and finite-band errors are separate constraints.

BOUNDARIES
The available native formula supports the algebraic reconstruction, not acquisition of the reported 44-site target. A Hermitian effective response can imply Im<y,z>=0 when z is genuinely its action, but no target/source mapping is acquired merely by that assertion. Small current denominators can require unbounded controls; zero-current cases need separate compatibility/rank analysis and may be nonunique or infeasible. A single-response solution does not certify arbitrary two-port scattering or continuous-band targets. The claimed five-mode optimum/stability failure, nine/ten real-mode counts, 151-point errors, local endpoint errors and Schur margins remain unacquired numerical source reports. Earlier N1030 support gaps remain open.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Charge the supplied complex target and complete bath calibration, N site energies and N-1 real hoppings, their magnitudes, precision and conditioning. A prefix sweep uses linear arithmetic work once exact y,z are supplied; bit cost and physical controls depend on their encoding and current denominators. The source reports 44 sites,43 hoppings, maxima8.81B/48.42B, calibrated bath coupling0.00054217 and memory shift40B; these are reported supplied-model resources, not acquired hardware or full-cycle costs.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the actual target vectors, calibrated full Hamiltonian/bath and numerical source files; check all input directions, positivity and continuous-band bounds together. Supply one Maxwell radiation/source model and finite-time preparation/capture/retrieval/reset with resource-matched comparators before claiming a device.

EXACT CLAIM
Stable scalar node potentials measured by genuine pairwise differences tolerate up to f arbitrary distinct bad edges universally iff edge connectivity>=2f+1. For12nodes,f2 a30-edge five-regular graph attains the degree lower bound; five disjoint path sums give exact medians or conservative honest-noise radii. If exactly5 instrument groups may include2 wholly bad groups, each group must instead be connected:55scalar outputs suffice and are necessary under that grammar. Recovered values have one common unknown offset. Fixed-dose Euclidean-simplex projection removes that offset; supplied Lipschitz bounds, feedback small gain and a computed residual certify later equilibria without new learner source calls.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
One stable globally connected latent vector across all sampled modules/positions; genuine difference-sensor orientations and a supplied total count of distinct faulty edges, or the separately specified whole-group model. Honest noise needs valid deterministic component budgets. Later tasks additionally require global spatial Lipschitz ceilings, a common gauge, known feedback/load, m>0 and certified q=(||K||+a)/m<1, with the stated projection operation.

BOUNDARIES
No probabilistic independence is required by the bounded-fault proofs. One instrument may corrupt several edges and thereby exceed an edge-count budget. The55scalar lower bound assumes exactly5 separately counted groups and pairwise differences, not arbitrary linear sensors or unlimited groups. Noisy path and scalar envelopes are outer, not sharp joint posteriors; only nonzero residuals in the exact synthetic fixture identify the two faults. One global offset is harmless for this fixed-dose operation; independent module offsets are not. Saved future-task labels reuse the same60 network/load cases, not independent physical systems. Vector/drift extensions and their528-label aggregate are outside accepted scope here.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
The selected scalar acquisition uses30 genuine scalar difference calls; group acquisition uses5vector calls returning11scalars each,55outputs. Later learner calls are0 under retained-source contracts. Count graph/path construction, rational arithmetic, storage,22bit iterate rounding,36bit norm enclosures and at least40320 source-aware reference component evaluations for the selected180labels, plus compatibility/checker work. Ordinary equally informed robust graph synchronization and Lipschitz retention can tie; physical sensors, fault bounds and regularity/calibration are supplied, not acquired capabilities.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire credible physical sensor semantics, failure units, global source regularity and stationarity before hardware use. Improve joint noisy/vector posterior reuse under actual observation geometry without importing edge guarantees into correlated instrument failures.

EXACT CLAIM
For a>0 and independent exponential correct/wrong races at each correctly reached stage j, B_j=sum_(k=1)^j b_k gives F_L=product_(j=0)^(L-1) a/(a+B_j). The accumulated hazard exposure is S_L=sum_j B_j/a=sum_(k=1)^(L-1)(L-k)b_k/a. Power-law contact assumptions give the source O(L^2),O(L log L),O(L) exposure cases; these are not generic exact asymptotics for -log F_L outside small hazards. A separate active/trapped model has P_j=a/[a+d_A+j*b*(x+d_T)/(r_esc+x+d_T)]. With no irreversible terms and r_esc>0, every stage eventually succeeds but E[T_L]=L/a+b*L*(L-1)/(2*a*r_esc). Thus retained sites can cause time cost without necessarily causing wrong products.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Supplied constant nonnegative rates, a>0, integer L>=1 and stage-specific exponential race/reset premises. B_j must count actual irreversible wrong joining for the first model. In the second model trapping returns the same competent active state, r_esc+x+d_T>0, and the lossless eventual-success/time result additionally requires r_esc>0. Actual polymer contacts, donor selection/escape and chemical processing are not acquired by the formulas.

BOUNDARIES
The absorption law explicitly reuses U1025-retained-product-diversion under a scoped rate/failure mapping. A positional-contact law is supplied, not measured for the proposed construct. For u_j=B_j/a, -log F_L=sum log(1+u_j), while S_L=sum u_j: linearization needs small hazards. For any b_1>0, F_L<=(a/(a+b_1))^(L-1), so even summable positional interference does not give nonvanishing long-chain fidelity at fixed rates. Reversible capture is not an irreversible error by definition; the effective hazard preserves absorption probability, not the full waiting-time law. Zero escape can make trapping permanent even with no chemical damage. Aging, correlated/nonexponential rates, changing competence and additional losses need a changed model. Old irreversible-mask survival remains valid at its own killing/initial-state interface. No integrated relay, empirical contact law, protecting-group performance or source numerical programme is accepted here.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay intended/wrong rates, accumulated positional exposure, trapping and escape time, actual donor clearance, parent aging, protection/capping/restoration damage and processing. The quadratic lossless mean time is a time cost, not a wrong-sequence probability. Source1024-step rate/assay/lifetime screens and ODE/Monte Carlo checks are reported only; current originals/results were not supplied. Full-cycle cost, ordinary matched comparator, practical advantage and priority remain open.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire actual retained-address recruitment, competent escape, aging/wrong-reaction rates and joint chemical compatibility. Compare complete fidelity/time/processing against a matched ordinary route before calling the proposed controller a working manufacture capability.

EXACT CLAIM
For N>=2 fixed positive reciprocal thermal-tree lumps, source-only initial energy and R=C_total/C_source>1, CV²>=1/[1+(N-1)tanh(log(R)/(2(N-1)))], sharply attained by positive ladders. Arbitrarily many lumps still require R>=exp(2(epsilon^-2-1)) for CV<=epsilon. A different autonomous single-reservoir memoryless curve g_min<=G(T)<=g_max with K=g_max/g_min>1 has optimum CV²=v, where 2(atanh(v)-v)=-log(1-1/K)-1/K; its low-to-high conductance threshold attains the bound in the measurable class.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Linear fixed reciprocal tree, one initially excited source, fixed-temperature bath and positive capacities/conductances for the first theorem. The second requires one constant-capacity reservoir, local memoryless G(T), finite contrast, no subsequent input and all leakage counted.

BOUNDARIES
Tree theorem does not cover loops, narrow-window concentration, nonlinear/scheduled switches or multiple excited nodes. RMS waveform width differs from timing jitter. Thermal ladder optimization maps to established OU optimal design. The continuum realization requires actual geometric regime: fixed capacity/material/delay do not independently make the slenderness parameter small. Physical switch examples do not supply the ideal local G(T); two-temperature closure/ON regimes cannot be blended. QP trajectory did not reproduce identically, although saved feasible objectives were checked. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Tree precision charges capacity ratio; timescale scaling is not precision. Switch CV scales K^-1/3 but needs actual conductance contrast, transition width, hysteresis/storage and threshold calibration. Fixed C,g_min,g_max do not allow independent mean-delay choice. The specified constant-power loading protocol needs P>g_max*theta and costs charging/reset.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire the whole compatible reservoir–switch–bath response, geometry, loading/reset and matched ordinary comparator before using the ideal frontier as a physical timing claim.

EXACT CLAIM
For fixed SPD storage and periodic reciprocal contacts, let Y be averaged terminal response and Y_* the static Kron reduction of the averaged graph. On terminal contrasts, Y_*-sym(Y)=<Z^T A Z>, a positive semidefinite matrix and Y^T Y_*^-1 Y<=sym(Y). Routing can be nonreciprocal but cannot improve total hot-subset cooling for two-level terminal temperatures in the admissible mean-conductance comparator class. With diagonal positive capacities, nonzero offdiagonal response occurs exactly along terminal-avoiding union-graph paths; forward and reverse zero patterns coincide.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Finite reciprocal bounded nonnegative periodic conductances, constant storage and unique stable periodic solution. Static comparison admits general SPD storage; positive-sign/support theorem additionally requires diagonal positive capacities. All terminal offsets constant, full repeated cycle, no internal sources/advection.

BOUNDARIES
A path through another clamped terminal is not a transmitting path. General SPD storage cannot inherit compartment positivity. The comparator requires feasible mean contacts; no assertion for every nonconvex actuator budget or every individual current at distinct temperatures. Finite isolation is possible; Float64 zero is not exact zero. At z800 reverse1.5282810767e-351 survives while the saved Float64 coefficient underflows. No universal approximate-router no-go. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Keep full period and cold preparation, parasitic/actuator heat, clock, contacts and resetting. Directionality trades against normalized symmetric loss. At extreme isolation the reported cooling is0.001875 of the matched static star; throughput and isolation targets differ.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Construct and calibrate compatible contacts and compare matched full-cycle cooling/routing costs; finite mathematical circulation is not a completed practical advantage.

EXACT CLAIM
An irreducible symmetric SPD M-matrix A is exactly reconstructed from n(n+1)/2 labeled scalar port responses to baseline, single shunts t/2t and pair shunts t, t>0. The inverse-M inequalities uniquely select the pair root. For K+sC with unknown positive internal shunt gains h_i, independently known diagonal C and two distinct positive real Laplace points identify all gains and K using n(n+1) scalar responses. Unknown C preserves the congruence ambiguity.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Known node count/labels and calibrated positive shunts for finite tomography; exact responses and connected SPD M-matrix. Self-calibration additionally needs independent absolute capacities, common known source/port calibration, h_0=1 and exact positive-real Laplace responses. These are not two sinusoidal frequencies.

BOUNDARIES
Exact real identifiability/count optimality does not imply robust physical recovery. Positive diagonal shunts cannot remove the hidden-loss depth barrier under the specified readout model. The stronger transient all-signed-input bound charges squared input, not physical work. Unequal-variance extension compares Gaussian KL, not Blackwell order. All8 noisy direct calibrations rejected or left the physical class; ordinary constrained joint fitting was stronger but small port error did not identify internal parameters. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Pay interventions, calibration, settling, finite pulse tail and reset cycles. Tail bias <=Q exp(-sT)/(s C_0 U(s)), variance sigma²(1-exp(-2sT))/(2s U(s)²); longer horizon leaves nonzero noise variance. Inverse conditioning/depth can amplify tiny errors. Full waveforms may be more informative than two summaries.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Acquire calibrated internal access or independent capacities and useful parameter-error bounds; validate noise/reset/physical work and compare full-data incumbents before claiming specimen identification.

EXACT CLAIM
For strictly positive rational column-stochastic 3x3 classical channels K,L, with L injective on zero-sum inputs, the all-finite-quantum-reference conditional-Umegaki coefficient has an exact three-LMI global certificate. K may be singular. A denominator-only operator covariance removes inverse K. Above one, scalar vertex certificates suffice; below one, a common rational center gives an exactly checkable upper bound and real active dimension at most two suffices in closure. The Umegaki active/vacuum lift needs one additional reference dimension. The selected portable evaluator returns exact rational upper certificates and lower witnesses; both reviewed implementations passed ten frozen asymmetric cases and three controls.

INTERFACE AND ASSUMPTIONS
Explicit positive rational K,L at a classical/dephasing input boundary; L must be informative (rank two on zero-sum inputs). Arbitrary finite complex noncommuting reference effects are allowed. Conditional/equal-reference semantics and free formula are inherited N965/N970/N1038 priors.

BOUNDARIES
No extension to zero channel entries, noninjective L or general coherent quantum-input channels. Tight width/runtime for every rational bit length is not proved. Adversarial anisotropic L leaves X68 a valid wide interval; selected X13 passed the nineteen reviewer probes. Frozen X68 batch checker accepted missing/duplicate coverage; separately credited post-review repair passed ten independent regressions and does not rewrite frozen outcomes. Generic free-convex/SOS machinery is historical prior; specialization priority UNKNOWN. Earlier SN-N1038-REVIEWED-SCOPE-20261026 records the former in-principle formula: its algorithmic gap is now closed only at this 3x3 interface, not uniformly for arbitrary alphabets.

COST AND INFORMATION BOUNDARY
Numerical optimization proposes; exact rational PSD minors and inverse quadratic witnesses establish bounds. Charge startup/imports, acquisition, checking, conditioning and serialization. Local reviewed thirteen-case process observations do not imply a uniform time/precision guarantee. Active-two is not total reference-two; faithful vacuum realization may converge slowly. No state-preparation or physical advantage acquired.

NEXT OBLIGATION
Improve certificate acquisition under extreme conditioning and compare with historical SOS including independent lower acquisition and full setup/checking costs. Preserve earlier equality/binary/finite-formula/refinement credit.

card_roles.text:
EXACT CLAIM
With bounded strain and common white Gaussian stress noise, a permanent spring and arbitrarily slow passive Maxwell alternatives become indistinguishable on every finite horizon while equilibrium modulus differs. Without a rate floor the fixed-horizon uniform minimax squared error is A²/4. Even unbounded random stopping cannot uniformly certify permanence at finite time more often than its allowed false-solid probability. A process-scoped adapter implements existing N24 rational cube/partition sparse-law semantics: exact positive weights, means, binary atoms, support<=n+1, frozen face and declared quotas. Untrusted numerical signs pass exact original row bounds or fall back to N24; retaining both opposite branches preserves the parent mean, and exact affine compression preserves it again. No new rounding theorem, sharper entropy bound, arbitrary-matroid transfer or added output capability. N24 parent retains its original review status; this audit does not promote its entire theorem. Zero natural rejections occurred under loose small-case envelopes; injected guards are separate tests. One selected post-hoc optimum does not alter frozen primary counts or establish a scalable algorithm/method winner.

Up to eight numerical proposals per uncached signing then exact fallback; exact rational checking, repeated compression and bit growth are charged. card_roles.text: Claim: For one material with local resistivity rho(T)=a+bT, b>0, a fixed uniformly positive symmetric geometry tensor M, independent local Johnson sources, and frozen temperature fluctuations, the dissipation-weighted noise temperature obeys T_N=T_R+(R/b)E, where E=integral grad(u-u*)^T M grad(u-u*) >= 0. If T_- <= T(x) <= T_+, then the sharp class-wide upper bound is T_N <= T_R + b(T_R-T_-)(T_+-T_R)/(a+bT_R).

Interface: The affine law, common material, stated boundary conditions, local Ohmic model, independent Johnson sources, quasistatic electrical response, and a frequency band where mean temperature fluctuations are frozen are required. Mixed materials, arbitrary nonlinear resistivity, thermoelectric terms, and endpoint attainability in every fixed geometry are excluded.

Proof spine: The source compares the physical potential with the terminal-calibrated potential in a weighted Dirichlet energy; the energy defect is nonnegative. Two-temperature series and parallel configurations establish sharpness over the allowed class.

Costs: A structural identity and bound; no inference algorithm or experimental acquisition cost is claimed.
Failure: It constrains a stated local transport class. It does not establish that a particular strange metal obeys that class or identify a microscopic mechanism.
Closest comparator: Established dissipation-weighted local-noise thermometry is cited; the candidate contribution is the affine-law identity and scoped sharp interval.
Open verification: Independently reconstruct the variational identity and boundary hypotheses, then test them against controlled device measurements before making a material-level inference.

card_roles.text: Claim: For a finite connected resistor network at uniform bath temperature, symmetric positive-definite thermal conductance A and heat capacity C, and a common positive fractional resistance slope c, the leading linearized Gaussian Langevin model defines H(omega)=q^T(A+i omega C)^(-1)q and H_0=H(0)>0. Near zero current, R(I)=R_0+c H_0 I^2+O(I^4) and Z(I,omega)=R(I)+2c I^2 H(omega)+O(I^4); the source also derives an eliminated leading-order relation for excess noise.

Interface: Finite connected network, uniform reference temperature, positive-definite A and C, common positive local fractional resistance derivative, current bias, independent equilibrium electrical and thermal noises, and the stated leading-order linearized Gaussian Langevin approximation. Thermoelectric effects, intrinsic field dependence, and nonlinear fluctuation-loop corrections are excluded.

Proof spine: Linearize the coupled electrical and thermal equations around zero bias, represent deposited Joule power by q, solve the thermal response with (A+i omega C)^(-1), and retain the quadratic current terms.

Costs: Finite-dimensional network formulas; no asymptotic algorithm or measurement-acquisition cost is asserted.
Failure: The relation is model-specific and leading-order, not an empirically validated microscopic bath model or a universal electrothermal feedback law.
Closest comparator: Noise thermometry and bolometer feedback are established topics; this is a relation inside a specified network Langevin model.
Open verification: Rebuild the covariance elimination independently and identify precise frequency and bias remainder bounds before applying it to material data.

scientific_excerpt.text: Claim: For a finite connected resistor network at uniform bath temperature, symmetric positive-definite thermal conductance A and heat capacity C, and a common positive fractional resistance slope c, the leading linearized Gaussian Langevin model defines H(omega)=q^T(A+i omega C)^(-1)q and H_0=H(0)>0. Near zero current, R(I)=R_0+c H_0 I^2+O(I^4) and Z(I,omega)=R(I)+2c I^2 H(omega)+O(I^4); the source also derives an eliminated leading-order relation for excess noise.

card_roles.text: Claim: For the supplied single-temperature local Ohm/Fourier model with positive w(T), kappa_hat(x,T)=w(T)sigma(x,T), frozen-profile Johnson noise, no thermoelectric terms, and energy conservation, W(T)=integral w and Theta=W^(-1) yield W(t(x))=W(T)+phi(x)[V-phi(x)]/2 and N(V,T)=integral_0^1 Theta(W(T)+V^2 s(1-s)/2) ds. The weak-bias curvature is alpha(T)=1/[12w(T)] and V partial_V N+N-T=3 alpha(T)V^2 partial_T N at fixed physical voltage.

Interface: Conductivity is symmetric and uniformly positive at the solution; w is positive and depends only on local temperature; a steady solution exists in the range of W; noise uses local Johnson sources with the mean profile frozen. The source's additional conductance formula requires separability.

Proof spine: Construct a sigma-harmonic heat potential from the steady equations, fix it by boundary values and a weak energy argument, then apply dissipation weighting to obtain the integral and eliminated differential identity.

Costs: Exact continuum identities under the stated PDE model; no solver or experimental acquisition complexity is established.
Failure: This does not cover arbitrary tensor misalignment, separate neutral and charged temperatures, arbitrary high-bias solution existence, or prove the assumed transport law for a particular material. Reported fits motivate but do not establish the exact surface.
Closest comparator: The heat-potential method and Wiedemann-Franz hot-electron case have cited antecedents; priority for the arbitrary-w generality is not established.
Open verification: Audit the weak PDE argument and derivative identity independently, then test the exact restrictions with independent parameters and measurements.

card_roles.text: Claim: For the supplied q_n functional on n qutrit pairs, if a complex rank-two matrix C has q_n(C)<0, then for every k>=3 with 2^(-k)<delta/2, delta=-q_n(C)/||C||_F^2, an explicitly constructed rank-two orthogonal projection P_k on n+2k qutrit pairs satisfies q_{n+2k}(P_k)<0. Its value approaches q_n(C)/2.
Interface: Local dimension is three; C has rank exactly two and a strictly negative value. Matrix rank, norm, and q_n are those defined in the supplied proof.

Proof spine: A coherent-flag identity extends a rank-two witness; a two-sided flag construction converts it to a flat rank-two projection and controls the quadratic-form error. The proof is stated for complex matrices.

Costs: The lift adds 2k qutrit pairs, with k logarithmic in the inverse normalized witness margin. Writing a general witness explicitly remains exponential in copy count; no efficient all-copy decision algorithm follows.
Failure: The theorem is conditional on an existing negative witness. It does not determine whether one exists, settle the all-copy endpoint or NPT bound entanglement, or provide a practical signal.
Closest comparator: Finite searches find near-zero values but no exact lower bound; the source separates the lifting theorem from the unresolved all-copy positivity endpoint.
Open verification: Independently reconstruct the flag and projection identities, then resolve the zero-versus-persistent-negative-gap dichotomy with an exact witness or all-copy bound.

card_roles.text: Claim: For exact Stieltjes samples g_i=G_nu(z_i) at m distinct upper-half-plane nodes, where nu is a law with exactly k distinct real atoms of positive weight convolved with semicircle variance t_0, the source proves {t>=0:S(t)>=0}=[0,t_0] whenever m>=k. The monotone feasibility boundary identifies t_0; when m=k, a Hermitian realization recovers atoms and weights.

Interface: Exact limiting transform samples; known k or an upper bound to choose m>=k; exactly k distinct real atoms with positive weights; additive semicircular noise. The m=k realization assumes the stated nondegenerate positive Pick matrix.

Proof spine: An entrywise Pick-kernel identity gives strict downward feasibility. At the planted variance the Pick covariance has rank at most k-1; strictness then identifies the entire feasible interval and rules out feasibility above it.

Costs: For m nodes, bisection uses O(m^3 log(U/epsilon)) arithmetic for Hermitian tests, plus O(Nm) to form samples from N supplied eigenvalues and O(m^3) for realization. Input matrix eigendecomposition is a separate shared cost.
Failure: This is not atom-count-free or exact for finite-N deformed-Wigner data. Adaptive-node finite-N stability is not certified, ordinary floating PSD signs are not certified, and non-atomic signals can confound removable semicircular variance.
Closest comparator: The source compares with nonconvex sparse free deconvolution, Hankel-boundary Gaussian deconvolution, and classical Hermitian realization; no broad first-boundary claim is made.
Open verification: Reconstruct the lemma and realization independently, add interval-certified feasibility, and evaluate finite-matrix errors against matched baselines.

card_roles.text: Claim: For continuous self-similar fragmentation with known alpha>0, gamma>0, monodisperse unit-mass start, and mass-tagged daughter law K satisfying integral K(ds)/s<infinity, the supplied result reconstructs the mean daughter measure from one finite-time mass-weighted endpoint by two causal linear integral equations.

Interface: Pure independent fragmentation without coagulation or growth; time-independent self-similar law; normalized mass conservation; known rates and calibrated complete mass-weighted endpoint. The small-chipping condition is required. The result recovers the mean daughter measure, not the joint sibling law.

Proof spine: A renewal convolution product conjugates the semigroup to a known multiplication semigroup. One Volterra equation recovers the conjugating measure; a second recovers K. The source gives uniqueness and finite-window stability arguments.

Costs: On a geometric grid, the two recurrences use O(N^2) arithmetic and O(N) storage.
Failure: Noise, arbitrary off-grid data, unknown initial spread, detector blur, unknown detection scale, and experimental validation are not covered by the base theorem. The focused AI proof and prior check are source-reported.
Closest comparator: The renewal spectral conjugacy is prior art; the candidate contribution is endpoint-driven inverse use. A matched finite-time baseline is supplied.
Open verification: Independently reconstruct continuous uniqueness and stability, validate mass-weighted observation calibration, and test noise/off-grid recovery against a forward solver.

Closest comparator: The source distinguishes actual marginal divergences from sliced score matching, which projects the joint score before squaring.

card_roles.text: Claim: For an exchangeable iid finite-state pool of N particles, finite controller, state-independent Poisson proposal mean A_T, and at most r labels revealed per proposal, capping permanently revealed labels at K gives a lower endpoint likelihood L_K(E) with 0<=L(E)-L_K(E)<=Pr(Poisson(A_T)>=floor(K/r)+1). For fixed K,q,r and controller state set, a histogram representation has at most |Z| binom(K+q,q) states before pruning, independent of N.

Interface: The initial pool is iid and independent of the controller; unrevealed particles evolve independently under known finite-state dynamics. Label selection is independent of hidden states, interactions fit the stated proposal/reveal form, and endpoints depend on controller and aggregate counts or a coarsening.

Proof spine: Condition on proposal history and revealed labels. The untouched pool remains conditionally iid, so terminal counts are multinomial. Killing trajectories beyond K discards mass bounded by the Poisson event that proposals reveal more than K labels.

Costs: For a fixed reveal cap, state count is independent of N. The interval bounds absolute likelihood error; endpoint weights in [0,M] multiply the tail by M. Floating ODE or matrix-exponential error is separate.
Failure: Correlated initial pools, hidden-state-dependent selection without a valid proposal representation, controller access to the hidden bulk, and repeated same-pool observations are excluded. Reported speed is a single-run comparison.
Closest comparator: Finite-state projection and uniformization already use Poisson-tail truncation; the candidate addition is revealed-pool closure under its exchangeable interaction model.
Open verification: Audit conditional independence and histogram transition rates, then add certified numerical error beyond the truncation tail.

Interface: Complete diamond-norm near-idempotence and self-compatibility of the whole channel, including references; finite-dimensional CPTP maps; precise imported factorization interface and smallness threshold; the report's local source-proof repair.
